sloka: भद्रं ते ऽस्तु गमिष्यामो वृत्रासुरवधैषिणः ।भजस्व परमोदार वासवं स्वेन तेजसा ।। ७.८५.९ ॥
transliteration: bhadraṁ te 'stu gamiṣyāmo vṛtrāsuravadhaiṣiṇaḥ ।bhajasva paramodāra vāsavaṁ svena tejasā ।। 7.85.9 ॥

translations.english: "May good fortune be with you; we shall now go, eager to slay Vritrasura, and O most generous one, you should empower Indra with your own might."
